gaps.description: May coaching layer ownership — runtime dependency with no owning track. May coaching layer consists of two runtime files: may-core.js (344,883 bytes, SHA-256: 183D2E6B...) and may-learner-state.js (110,240 bytes, SHA-256: BEE72B86...). Both are referenced by index_updated.html and tracked in CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1. The coaching engine interacts with app.js (100-series) and consumes Certified pool data. No lane has formally accepted ownership.

(3) Coaching-layer bug fixes follow 100-series boundary rules (MAY: fix runtime bugs; MAY NOT: create new coaching content, modify pack content). gaps.description: G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 enforcement in 800-series certification pipeline. G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 are certification-blocking conditions defined in QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4 (effective Session 508, 2026-07-25). They block certification when: (G-NEW-1) dual-block Choice mismatch, (G-NEW-2) ExplanationWrong topic mismatch, (G-NEW-3) dual-block source-of-truth verification gap, (G-NEW-4) case explanation insufficiency, (G-NEW-5) within-object CC extraction. The 800-series certification pipeline currently does not programmatically enforce these rules at scale.
gaps.current_state: G-NEW rules exist in QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4 but no enforcement mechanism in the 800-series certification pipeline.
gaps.resolved_owner: Certification Auditor (800-series) — primary enforcer at every certification wave gate. Defect Sweeper (700-series) — secondary auditor detecting G-NEW violations in Certified items during Rapid Pulse and Deep Audits.
gaps.acceptance_criteria: (1) Every 800-series certification wave includes a G-NEW verification gate before 'Certified' state assignment. (2) Certification Auditor logs G-NEW pass/fail per wave in REVISION_HISTORY.md. (3) Defect Sweeper's Rapid Pulse audit (every 5 sessions) includes a G-NEW re-verification sweep on newly Certified items. (4) Any G-NEW violation found in a Certified item is escalated as CRITICAL (learner-safety risk per DL-016 severity upgrade).
gaps.accepting_entity: Certification Auditor (800-series) + Defect Sweeper (700-series) — per Agent O Stewardship Framework §4.5
transition_steps: Step 1: Certification Auditor reads QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4 (all G-NEW rules, all examples, all blocking conditions).

Step 2: Certification Auditor integrates G-NEW gate into 800-series certification wave template: before state transition, verify (a) no dual-block Choice mismatch (G-NEW-1), (b) no EW topic mismatch (G-NEW-2), (c) content-block CC is source of truth (G-NEW-3), (d) case explanations meet sufficiency requirements (G-NEW-4), (e) CC extracted within same enclosing object (G-NEW-5).
Step 3: Defect Sweeper adds G-NEW verification to Rapid Pulse checklist (M2_RAPID_PULSE, RP-CHK-4 — NEW).
Step 4: Both Certification Auditor and Defect Sweeper log acceptance in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
Step 5: Governance Board confirms G-NEW enforcement at next stewardship review.
gaps.severity: CRITICAL (certification without G-NEW enforcement risks certifying items with topic-mismatched or dual-block-contradicted explanations — learner-safety risk per DL-016 HIGH severity upgrade)
gaps.agent_o_lane_reference: Portfolio Lane Map §Lane 800 — G-NEW enforcement is a mandatory certification wave gate. Ownership Matrix row 11 — G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 enforcement.

gaps.agent_e_reference: Not separately enumerated by Agent E (merged into GAP-4/GAP-5 scope)
gaps.description: Defect manifest maintenance after remediation — who updates DEFECT_LIBRARY.md and the DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026.json after remediation completes? DEFECT_LIBRARY.md catalogs 33 defect entries (DL-001 through DL-033). Multiple remediation sessions across different lanes (700-series DL-008 sweeps, 800-series certification waves, autonomous runs) modify pack files to fix defects. But DEFECT_LIBRARY.md updates are inconsistent — some remediations are documented in REVISION_HISTORY.md but the defect library entry's 'Status' and 'Resolved' sections are not contemporaneously updated.
gaps.current_state: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md updates are inconsistent and not owned. Remediations are recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md but the defect library status fields lag behind actual state.
gaps.resolved_owner: Defect Sweeper (700-series) — primary responsibility for DEFECT_LIBRARY.md maintenance
gaps.secondary_owner: Certification Auditor (800-series) — cross-checking defect status during certification waves
gaps.acceptance_criteria: (1) After every remediation batch (any lane, any defect), the Defect Sweeper updates the corresponding DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry within the same session. (2) 'Status' field reflects current state (Open/Resolved/In Progress). (3) 'Resolved' section captures date, count, and cross-reference to the remediation session. (4) No remediated defect is marked 'Open' in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md more than one session after remediation completion. (5) DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026.json updated contemporaneously if May coaching layer active.
gaps.accepting_entity: Defect Sweeper (700-series) — per Agent O Stewardship Framework §4.2
transition_steps: Step 1: Defect Sweeper accepts ownership (per Agent E Principle 2 protocol).
Step 2: Defect Sweeper audits all 33 DL entries against current pack-file state — flags any discrepancy between documented status and actual state.
Step 3: For each discrepancy, either (a) update DEFECT_LIBRARY.md to match actual state, or (b) if the remediation was incomplete, re-open the defect.
Step 4: Defect Sweeper establishes protocol: any remediation agent must append a status-change note to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md before their session closes (per AGENTS.md §12 — 'No Staged Findings').
Step 5: Log acceptance and audit results in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
gaps.transition_deadline: Before S726 T0 (audit of all 33 DL entries); ongoing — before every remediation agent session close
gaps.severity: HIGH (inconsistent defect status tracking misleads governance decisions and certification wave planning)
gaps.agent_o_lane_reference: Ownership Matrix rows 2 and 10 — Defect Sweeper is primary owner for both defect library maintenance and defect manifest updates. Portfolio Lane Map §700-series.
